description: The typed, sourced claims behind one market's rating: each has claim_id, predicate, value, unit, as_of, method, confidence and sources. Newer responses add a copy-paste `citation` ending in a permanent URL; when it is absent, cite the claim's own sources and claim_id. Use to quote a specific finding with attribution. The response also lists `gaps` (see pgiq_gaps). Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.

market.description: Market id (public slug), e.g. 'ontario', 'ercot', 'ireland'. Use pgiq_markets to list ids.

name: pgiq_claims
